title: gate add classes a gate as secrets when its text says output tokens
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons does not class a gate as secrets because its question, options or command words say tokens in the sense of a model's token counts (output tokens, token counts) or name a Markdown doc whose file name holds token (the token-efficiency doc under kb/_self), as names_secret already exempts for touches; a credential-sense token (bearer token, access token, API token, PAT) or a token file still classes it secrets, and a bare token word with no such sense stays secrets (gate g1)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as a; c=a.class_reasons({}, {"id":"g1","question":"Which count is the output tokens?","options":["the main loop","the whole run"]})[0]; assert c!="secrets", c

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as a; c=lambda q,t=[]: a.class_reasons({"touches":t},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["yes","no"]})[0]; assert c("Which count is the output tokens?")!="secrets"; assert c("Does kb/_self/token-efficiency.md name the figure?")!="secrets"; assert c("Where is the bearer token kept?")=="secrets"; assert c("Is api.token committed?")=="secrets"

gates.question: Which reading of a bare token word with no credential or token-count word around it does the secrets class keep?
options: a bare token stays secrets; only the token-count words and a Markdown doc name are exempt
a bare token no longer classes secrets; only credential words and token files do
gates.recommendation: a bare token stays secrets; only the token-count words and a Markdown doc name are exempt
gates.answer: a bare token stays secrets; only the token-count words and a Markdown doc name are exempt
